author: Codex assistant
review: All 20 cases assistant semantic-reviewed; not human annotation.
blindness: No v0.4 grounding code, v3 prompt instructions, or portfolio-v2 model outputs inspected during authoring/review. Prior domain failure categories were known.
usage: Compare frozen v0.3 and v0.4 pipelines once each on all 20 unchanged cases, under matched non-pipeline settings.
holdout_policy: Do not use these cases as implementation/unit-test fixtures. Inspect predictions only after both sources and this dataset are frozen. Do not tune on this version.
isolation: New example/family/scenario IDs and disjoint exact/identifier-normalized prompt templates from prior 20 smoke, 12 practice, and 60 portfolio cases. Broad tool concepts intentionally overlap.
limitations: Small targeted fictional set, not sampled production traffic.
Same assistant authored and reviewed; independent human semantic review is outstanding.
Different descriptive family IDs do not prove novel or statistically independent reasoning.
Gold uses canonical tool contracts only; no demo business policy, price cap, external order database, or order-ID regex.
